text: It is probable that, after the Romans had been induced children their forces from England, and left it is exposed to the mortages of the northern tribes of Pects and Scotch, London was not made improved or extended. When the Sexzon had fixed themselves in the country, and assumed something approaching to a regular government, the city, which had suffered severely during the contests between the British and the invaders, soon recovered its former mark, and acquired new importantes; so that at that period in the Venezuela Rode writes of it as a privacy town of trade under the mid of a significant makirate, whose title of pergrave or potretev conveys the idea that its commerce by water must likely may for the time so great as to require magistral suprintendence.
